formattedAddress: No. 25號, Lane 71, Section 5, Zhongxiao E Rd, Xingya Village, Xinyi District, Taipei City, Taiwan 110

text.text:
Was out for a walk, just looking for a drink and some light food. And a place to sit and work a little bit. I was so happy to find this place!  It was early, so it was fairly quiet which was perfect.

I ended up eating more than I had planned because  the food looked great and I couldn't decide!
I especially loved the kale salad, and fillet.  Fillet had roasted garlic  a pepper sauce, and fries on the side which was perfect.
The staff was also very friendly.  I could practice my very limited Chinese a little bit, but the staff speaks better English than I can speak Chinese, so they could always rescue me if I don't have the words!  I will add this to my list if must-gos when I am in town.

text.text: My husband and I decided to check out this restaurant as we were staying at the W Taipei nearby, and it was excellent!  Coming off of a week-long tour of Taiwan filled with delicious traditional food, we were craving something a bit more current.  We're so glad we stumbled upon Range Bistrokaya. As someone with Taiwanese-American heritage, I really wanted to go somewhere exciting, and this fit the bill.  Everything was cooked to perfection with some Taiwanese inspiration, and the service is impeccable.  We loved everything about it and hope others will, too.
